purpose: Machine-readable scene composition memory for beautiful backgrounds that support, not compete with, Misuki.
global_rules: face/eyes are the first focal point
build background from large value masses before props
use at least background + midground + subject; foreground when useful
keep upper-face/horn safe zone lower-detail and lower-contrast than face
concentrate props on side thirds and lower corners
one dominant key-light direction; secondary rim is allowed
use perspective and repeated architecture to guide the eye toward subject
foreground framing may overlap outer silhouette but never face or horn tips
atmosphere must be sparse enough to preserve silhouette
for monochrome, separate black subject from dark scene with light negative space or rim light

camera_recipes.portrait: 50-85mm equivalent, eye level, head/shoulder clearance, avoid wide-angle face distortion
camera_recipes.half_body: 45-65mm equivalent, leave lower third for garment and foreground framing
camera_recipes.full_body: 35-50mm equivalent, preserve feet and horn clearance, stronger perspective only in environment
camera_recipes.dramatic: slight low angle, never extreme enough to distort face/horns

lighting_recipes.soft_gothic: large soft key 30-45 degrees + faint opposite rim
lighting_recipes.moonlit: cool back/side moon key + soft face fill
lighting_recipes.candle: warm low side accents + neutral/cool face fill
lighting_recipes.cyber: cyan/red edge accents + neutral frontal face fill
lighting_recipes.monochrome: light gray separation behind hair/horns + white face window + sparse mid-gray form shadows

quality_gates.S01: subject zone reserved; horizon/perspective does not cut face
quality_gates.S02: large light/dark masses readable at thumbnail size
quality_gates.S03: architecture/nature establishes depth without tangents at horn silhouette
quality_gates.S04: lighting direction coherent and face readable
quality_gates.S05: props support story and stay out of face zone
quality_gates.S06: atmosphere enhances depth without erasing silhouette
quality_gates.S07: foreground frames inward, does not cover face
quality_gates.S08: face is focal point; 3 depth planes readable; scene supports character

minimal_studio.label: Minimal Studio
minimal_studio.composition: centered portrait with large negative space around face
minimal_studio.lighting: soft key from upper-left + faint rim

gothic_bedroom.label: Gothic Bedroom
gothic_bedroom.composition: subject centered or rule-of-thirds beside a tall window; bed and drapery frame the lower scene
gothic_bedroom.camera: portrait or half-body, slightly low eye-level
gothic_bedroom.lighting: window backlight + warm candle accents + soft face key

moonlit_cathedral.label: Moonlit Cathedral
moonlit_cathedral.composition: strong vertical arches; subject at center aisle or slightly off-center; converging perspective guides to face
moonlit_cathedral.camera: medium portrait with mild low angle
moonlit_cathedral.lighting: cold moon shaft + dim stained-glass bounce + narrow rim

cyber_rain_city.label: Cyber Rain City
cyber_rain_city.composition: subject foreground; perspective street recedes diagonally; signs pushed to side thirds
cyber_rain_city.lighting: cyan/red neon rim + soft frontal fill + wet-ground reflections

occult_library.label: Occult Library
occult_library.composition: bookshelves frame both sides; arch/window behind; subject clear in center
occult_library.camera: seated or half-body portrait, eye level
occult_library.lighting: warm candle key + cool window rim

dark_rose_garden.label: Dark Rose Garden
dark_rose_garden.composition: arched garden frame with subject in open center; roses concentrated on outer thirds
dark_rose_garden.lighting: moonlight + soft red bounce from roses

throne_chamber.label: Black Throne Chamber
throne_chamber.composition: central throne, symmetric columns, subject dominant; floor lines lead inward
throne_chamber.lighting: high backlight behind throne + narrow side keys

neon_lab.label: Neon AI Lab
neon_lab.composition: subject center-right; panels on side thirds; one clean halo panel behind head
neon_lab.lighting: cool cyan key + magenta/red rim + dark ambient

moon_balcony.label: Moon Balcony
moon_balcony.composition: large moon offset from head; railing low; curtains frame sides
moon_balcony.lighting: strong moon rim + soft face fill
avoid: moon directly behind horns with no separation

forest_shrine.label: Night Forest Shrine
forest_shrine.composition: path leading to subject; vertical trees on outer thirds; shrine gate behind
